Nodes.Text: Mind the lamp; your sleeve is close. This is the Rooted. That's his living plume you're looking at. We sit here when the light is low.

Choices.Text: How may I be trusted here?
May I sleep on the plume?
You recognized me before I spoke.

Nodes.Text: The First Root is beyond the eastern wall. A long way through the stone. He's had his arms open toward it for a thousand years. We leave the space before his fingertips clear; there's room to walk around.

The tender is working at our oldest wall. She needs a chip of tepuibone for a crumbling edge. There are pale seams upstairs, on the Stump's slopes. Take her one and stay while she speaks the name. If you've hurt a hearth, she won't forget it for a stone.

Choices.Text: I will speak with the tender.

Nodes.Text: There is room beside his chest. Lie on the living plume, near the light. Wait until it's quiet; nobody sleeps well with trouble at the door. I keep a lamp here for waking guests. You can sit a while before you tell anyone what you've heard.
Patch-bloom. My sister carried it for weeks after she slept here. I knew you'd been spoken to. I do not know what he said; that belongs to you.
Come and sit on the warm side. You need not make the fragments into a speech for me. If you want to talk later, I'll be here.

Keep the lamp low, please. My mother taught me this row. The edge is giving way under the last syllable; a chip of tepuibone would brace it while I work. Bring one from the Stump's slopes, if you can. Stay while I speak the name. It's easier to keep one with someone listening.

Choices.Text: Place one tepuibone chip beside the inscription and listen.
Tell me how you tend him.
Leave the lamp where it is.

Nodes.Text: I wipe the stalks and turn the lamps, as I would at any of our hearths. That light is coming from his chest. Mind your blade near it, please. Hurt him and you won't find a welcome at our other hearths either.
The edge is holding. Thank you for staying. If you're tired, speak to the elder; he'll help you find a place beside the light.
